+"""Plan light correction paths through large missing-ink regions."""
+import numpy as np

+
+def longest_path_for_label(c):
+    ys,xs=OBJS[c-1]
+    y0=max(0,ys.start-3);x0=max(0,xs.start-3)
+    y1=min(1024,ys.stop+3);x1=min(1024,xs.stop+3)
+    m=L[y0:y1,x0:x1]==c
+    sk=thin(m)
+    adj=pixel_graph(sk)
+    if not adj:return None
+    ends=[u for u in adj if len(adj[u])==1]
+    if len(ends)<2:ends=list(adj)
+    best=(-1,None)
+    allowed=set(adj)
+    for u in ends:
+        dist,prev=shortest_from(adj,u,allowed)
+        for v in ends:
+            if dist.get(v,-1)>best[0]:best=(dist[v],(u,v,prev))
+    u,v,prev=best[1]
+    path=[v]
+    while path[-1]!=u:path.append(prev[path[-1]])
+    path=path[::-1]
+    arr=np.asarray(path,float)
+    arr[:,0]+=y0;arr[:,1]+=x0
